meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 让 Claude 通过本会话的 Iron Proxy 访问外部账号和 API(如 GitHub 的 gh):它运行连接命令并给出 connect_url 交由运维配置,遇到 403 时报告主机名与错误、请求主机侧排查,全程不接触真实令牌。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 访问外部账号或 API(如 GitHub),或请求被代理以 403 拦截时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接 GitHub 账号
我访问 api.example.com 被 403 挡了,帮我看看
say.note: 它会报告主机名和错误,请求运维侧排查

say.text: 用 gh 列出我的仓库
say.note: 用 gateway-managed 占位,不用真实令牌

howto.what_en: Claude reaches external accounts and APIs (like GitHub via gh) through your session's Iron Proxy: it runs the connect command and returns a connect_url for the operator console, reports blocked hosts and errors, and never handles real tokens.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask Claude to reach an external account or API (like GitHub), or when a proxied request comes back as a 403.

say_en.note: Runs ncl groups connect and returns the connect_url

say_en.text: My request to api.example.com got a 403
say_en.note: Reports hostname and error, asks for a host-side check

say_en.text: Use gh to list my repos
say_en.note: Uses the gateway-managed placeholder, no real token
